product_overview: TestSprite is an AI-driven, IDE-integrated testing platform that automatically generates, executes, and reviews frontend and backend tests against a locally running application via the Model Context Protocol. It also produces standardized PRDs and code summaries to bridge the gap between code and specification.
core_goals: Automatically analyze a project's codebase and generate comprehensive frontend and backend test plans.
Execute generated tests against a local dev or production server with minimal setup and provide an interactive dashboard for results review and re-run.
Integrate natively into the Cursor IDE via MCP for an in-editor workflow and session state persistence.
Provide standardized documentation (PRDs, code summaries) derived from source to improve onboarding and alignment.
Support safe, repeatable test execution while surfacing security and operational limitations (e.g., auth checks, rate limiting).

features.name: testsprite_bootstrap
features.description: One-time project initialization that creates .testsprite/config.json and registers the project with TestSprite's backend.
user_flows: Invoke testsprite_bootstrap with { localPort: 3000, type: "backend", projectPath: "/path/to/project", testScope: "codebase" } -> Receive 201 and .testsprite/config.json created with session metadata
Invoke testsprite_bootstrap when .testsprite/config.json already exists -> Receive 409 and error indicating bootstrap must not be re-run

features.name: testsprite_generate_code_summary
features.description: Analyze the repository and return a structured code summary (files, modules, key endpoints).
user_flows: Invoke testsprite_generate_code_summary with { projectRootPath: "/path/to/project" } -> Receive 200 and JSON code summary (file tree, key modules, endpoints)
Invoke testsprite_generate_code_summary with missing or inaccessible projectRootPath -> Receive 400 with validation error

features.name: testsprite_generate_standardized_prd
features.description: Generate a standardized Product Requirements Document from the codebase analysis.
user_flows: Invoke testsprite_generate_standardized_prd with { projectPath: "/path/to/project" } -> Receive 200 and generated PRD (markdown / structured JSON)
Invoke testsprite_generate_standardized_prd for an empty or unsupported projectPath -> Receive 400 with descriptive error

features.name: testsprite_generate_backend_test_plan
features.description: Generate a backend test plan covering API endpoints and server logic based on code analysis.
user_flows: Invoke testsprite_generate_backend_test_plan with { projectPath: "/path/to/project" } -> Receive 200 and a test plan (list of test IDs and descriptions)
Invoke testsprite_generate_backend_test_plan when analysis artifacts are missing -> Receive 422 with reason (analysis required)

features.name: testsprite_generate_frontend_test_plan
features.description: Generate a frontend test plan for UI interactions and flows, optionally including login sequences.
user_flows: Invoke testsprite_generate_frontend_test_plan with { projectPath: "/path/to/project", needLogin: true } -> Receive 200 and frontend test plan including login flows
Invoke testsprite_generate_frontend_test_plan with invalid projectPath or unsupported framework detection -> Receive 400 with guidance

features.name: testsprite_generate_code_and_execute
features.description: Generate runnable test code from a test plan and execute it against the locally running application, returning a results report.
user_flows: Invoke testsprite_generate_code_and_execute with { projectName: "pixora", projectPath: "/path/to/pixora", testIds: [], additionalInstruction: "", serverMode: "development" } -> Local tests run sequentially against localEndpoint -> Example run steps: POST /api/auth/signup with {name,email,password} -> Receive 200 with { token, user } -> POST /api/auth/signin with {email,password} -> Receive 200 with { token, user } -> GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token -> Receive 200 User object -> POST /api/contact-messages with {name,email,message} -> Receive 200 { success:true, message } -> POST /api/chat/ai with Bearer token and {conversationId,message} -> Receive 200 { userMessage, aiMessage } -> POST /api/stripe/create-subscription-session with Bearer token and {agencyId,priceId} -> Receive 200 { url } -> Test run completes and generate combined report (markdown) with pass/fail per step

Invoke testsprite_generate_code_and_execute when local server is not reachable at configured localEndpoint -> Attempt to run tests -> Fail on first API call with connection error -> Receive 503 and test run aborted with diagnostic details

features.name: testsprite_open_test_result_dashboard
features.description: Open an interactive dashboard to review, edit, and re-run test executions.
user_flows: Invoke testsprite_open_test_result_dashboard with { projectPath: "/path/to/project" } after tests executed -> Receive 200 and dashboard URL -> Open dashboard to view test run details and re-run individual test steps
Invoke testsprite_open_test_result_dashboard before any tests have been executed -> Receive 404 or guidance response indicating no results available

features.name: testsprite_check_account_info
features.description: Retrieve TestSprite account info including plan and credits.
user_flows: Invoke testsprite_check_account_info -> Receive 200 with { name, email, subscriptionPlan, availableCredits }
Invoke testsprite_check_account_info with expired session -> Receive 401 and prompt to re-authenticate

features.name: Authentication - Sign Up
features.description: Register a new user and receive a JWT token.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signup with body { name, email, password } -> Receive 200 with { token, user }
POST /api/auth/signup with existing email -> Receive 409 Email already exists

features.name: Authentication - Sign In
features.description: Authenticate an existing user and return a JWT token.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signin with body { email, password } -> Receive 200 with { token, user }
POST /api/auth/signin with incorrect password -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials

features.name: Authentication - Current User
features.description: Retrieve the current user profile using a Bearer JWT.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signin with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with { token, user } -> GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 User object
GET /api/auth/me with missing or invalid Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Authentication - Forgot Password
features.description: Request an OTP code to be sent to the user's email for password reset.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/forgot-password with body { email } -> Receive 200 { message: "OTP sent" }
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with unknown email -> Receive 404 User not found

features.name: Authentication - Verify OTP
features.description: Verify an OTP and return a reset token for password change.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/verify-otp with body { email, otp } -> Receive 200 { resetToken }
POST /api/auth/verify-otp with incorrect otp -> Receive 400 Invalid OTP

features.name: Authentication - Reset Password
features.description: Reset the user's password using a reset JWT token.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/reset-password with Authorization: Bearer <resetToken> and body { token: "<resetToken>", password: "newPass" } -> Receive 200 { message: "success" }
POST /api/auth/reset-password with expired or invalid token -> Receive 400 Invalid or expired token

features.name: Contact Messages (Public)
features.description: Submit a public contact message via the contact form.
user_flows: POST /api/contact-messages with body { name, email, subject?, message } -> Receive 200 { success: true, message: ContactMessage }
POST /api/contact-messages with missing required fields (e.g., message) -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Contact Messages - Reply (Staff)
features.description: Agency staff reply to a contact message via email and mark it replied.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signin with staff credentials -> Receive 200 with { token } -> POST /api/contact-messages/reply with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { messageId, replySubject, replyBody } -> Receive 200 { success: true }
POST /api/contact-messages/reply without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: AI Chat
features.description: Send a message to a configured AI provider and receive the AI response (supports provider errors like rate limits and auth).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signin with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with { token } -> POST /api/chat/ai with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { conversationId, message } -> Receive 200 { userMessage, aiMessage }
POST /api/chat/ai with valid request when AI provider credential invalid -> Receive 401 Invalid API key
POST /api/chat/ai with high request volume -> Receive 429 Rate limit exceeded

features.name: Chat - Send Message
features.description: Persist a direct chat message between users and trigger a Pusher realtime event.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signin -> Receive 200 with { token } -> POST /api/chat/send with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { conversationId, content } -> Receive 200 ChatMessage (Pusher event emitted)
POST /api/chat/send without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Stripe - Create Subscription Session
features.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for agency plan subscription.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signin -> Receive 200 with { token } -> POST /api/stripe/create-subscription-session with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { agencyId, priceId } -> Receive 200 { url: string }
POST /api/stripe/create-subscription-session without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Stripe - Cancel Subscription
features.description: Schedule a subscription to be canceled at period end.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signin -> Receive 200 with { token } -> POST /api/stripe/cancel-subscription with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body { agencyId } -> Receive 200 { success: true }
POST /api/stripe/cancel-subscription with invalid agencyId -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Stripe - Webhook
features.description: Receive and process Stripe webhook events (checkout, subscription, invoice) using raw body signature verification.
user_flows: POST /api/stripe/webhook with raw Stripe event payload and valid signature header -> Receive 200 { received: true }
POST /api/stripe/webhook with invalid signature header -> Receive 400 Invalid signature

features.name: Stripe - Products (CRUD)
features.description: List, create, and delete products (local or Stripe-synced) for sub-accounts.
user_flows: GET /api/stripe/products?subAccountId=<id> -> Receive 200 Product[]
POST /api/stripe/products with body { name, price, subAccountId } -> Receive 200 Product
DELETE /api/stripe/products with body { productId } -> Receive 200 { success: true }
POST /api/stripe/products with invalid or missing fields -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Stripe - Plan Prices
features.description: Return available plan price IDs (mapping for PRO and AGENCY plans).
user_flows: GET /api/stripe/plan-prices -> Receive 200 { PRO: priceId, AGENCY: priceId }
GET /api/stripe/plan-prices during DB outage -> Receive 500 Internal server error

features.name: Stripe - Create Checkout Session (Connect)
features.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for cart purchases routed via Connect to sub-accounts.
user_flows: POST /api/stripe/create-checkout-session with body { subAccountId, items, funnelPageId } -> Receive 200 { url: string }
POST /api/stripe/create-checkout-session with invalid cart items -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Plan Limits
features.description: Return whether an agency can create sub-accounts or invite team members based on plan limits.
user_flows: GET /api/plan-limits?agencyId=<id> -> Receive 200 { canCreateSubAccount, canInviteTeamMember }
GET /api/plan-limits with unknown agencyId -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Media - List Uploads
features.description: List uploaded media files for a sub-account.
user_flows: GET /api/media?subAccountId=<id> -> Receive 200 Media[]
GET /api/media without subAccountId or with invalid id -> Receive 400 Validation error
